title: Outdated numeric values from Norwegian statutes and regulations in a further-trained model and its base model: a preregistered paired comparison of Borealis 2 and Gemma 4
abstract: arXiv:2611.02334v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We compare how often two released language models give outdated numeric values from Norwegian statutes and regulations: NbAiLab/borealis2-26b-a4b-preview (Borealis 2), which the National Library of Norway further trained from google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (Gemma 4), and Gemma 4 itself. The study was preregistered (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965) and uses the closed norregel benchmark, scored deterministically against a value history. On the 411 of 503 primary items where both models gave an interpretable answer, Borealis 2 alone was outdated on 10 items and Gemma 4 alone on 11 (d = -0.2 percentage points, 95% cluster bootstrap interval [-2.7, +2.5], exact one-sided McNemar p = 0.668). By the preregistered rule this is no effect of interest: the whole interval lies within the smallest effect of interest of +/-10 percentage points. Among the secondary measures, only the share of answers giving a value that took effect after the question date diff

translated_title: 进一步训练模型与其基础模型在挪威法律法规数值上的过时情况：Borealis 2 与 Gemma 4 的预注册配对比较
translated_abstract: 我们比较了两个已发布的语言模型给出挪威法律法规过时数值的频率：一个是挪威国家图书馆基于 google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it（Gemma 4）进一步训练的 NbAiLab/borealis2-26b-a4b-preview（Borealis 2），另一个是 Gemma 4 本身。该研究已预先注册（doi:10.5281/zenodo.23858965），使用封闭的 norregel 基准测试，并根据数值历史进行确定性评分。在 503 个主要条目中，两个模型都给出可解释答案的 411 个条目里，仅 Borealis 2 给出过时数值的有 10 个条目，仅 Gemma 4 给出过时数值的有 11 个条目（d = -0.2 个百分点，95% 聚类自助区间 [-2.7, +2.5]，精确单侧 McNemar 检验 p = 0.668）。根据预注册的判定规则，这不构成感兴趣的效应：整个置信区间落在 +/-10 个百分点的最小感兴趣效应范围之内。在次要测量指标中，只有给出在问题日期之后才生效的数值的答案比例存在差异（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 一项预注册的配对比较研究表明，经挪威国家图书馆进一步训练的 Borealis 2 与其基础模型 Gemma 4 在回答挪威法律法规数值时，给出过时信息的比例并无显著差异。
en_tdlr: A preregistered paired comparison shows that the further-trained Borealis 2 does not differ significantly from its base model Gemma 4 in producing outdated numeric values from Norwegian statutes and regulations.
